question: How often does a roll land on a printed oddity?

series.label: % of rolls that land on the odd cell

finding: Comes up in play and needs a ruling: defender +2: no row for 34-36 (8.3 % of the rolls read there); morale -4: no cell for 56 (2.8 % of the rolls read there). Cannot occur, since the odd part is not a reading two dice can make: attacker -2: 20 % row reads 13-18.
